style: 16-bit pixel art game art, crisp hard-edged pixels, limited night palette: plum black, deep plum, violet glow, cream, sunset orange, warm orange and gold window lights, the career accent colour only on screens and small glows. Dusk City at night: a skyline made of lit window dots, a few still stars
suffix: no people, no faces, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no sunburst rays, no perspective floor grid, no scanlines, no grain, no glowing particles

assets.prompt: a university campus bus stop at night under a warm street lamp, a small shuttle bus pulling away with its tail lights glowing, in the middle a large generic smartphone propped on the bus stop bench, its screen showing a cornflower blue route map with a glowing bus marker on a curving line, campus buildings and the lit city behind, no app logos

a desk at night, in the middle two monitors side by side: the left one shows an inbox of seven blank message cards in cornflower blue, the top card marked with a small red flag, the right one shows rows of abstract cornflower blue code bars with one line highlighted orange, a small yellow rubber duck beside the keyboard, a row of sticky notes on the monitor edge, a window onto the night city

a school desk at night, in the middle an open orange portfolio binder, beside it a phone showing a cornflower blue exam timetable app of blank boxes, a small cream piggy bank with a few coins next to a laptop with blue code bars, a small university gate on a far hill seen through the window

a desk at night, in the middle a laptop showing a simple one page website in cornflower blue with a header bar, a blank picture box and one rounded button and no words, a phone lying beside it showing the same small page, a warm desk lamp, the moon in the window, a small orange flag planted beside the laptop

a rooftop at the edge of the city just before sunrise, a thin orange band of first light on the horizon, in the middle a laptop open on a low wooden crate with cornflower blue code bars on its screen, a path of glowing blue tiles in front of it forking into two, one fork leading to a building with a giant glowing phone app window, the other to a building with a big magnifying glass over a small bug shape, a small orange flag at the fork
a vertical top-down game world map at night: five small dark islands in a deep plum sea, tiny lit windows on each island, no path, no labels
a chunky pixel picture frame, green outer border, orange corner studs, deep plum dithered interior with a few stars, empty centre
the PassionSeed flame logo as a pixel game host: yellow flame body, black face, big white eyes, holding a small mic, transparent background
the same flame host, mouth open mid-sentence, transparent background
the same flame host winking, transparent background
the same flame host, flame tips swayed one pixel, transparent background
the same flame host with eyes shut mid blink, transparent background
the same flame host cheering, eyes closed happily, wide grin, transparent background
